flash_337075.description:
Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Yom Kippur in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Monday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Yom Kippur at 19:14 Jerusalem time.

Gmar Chatima Tova!

flash_693853.description:
UEFA rejects Ireland’s request to avoid future matchups with Israel, citing its case-by-case policy and the lack of a direct conflict between the countries.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Yom Kippur in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_693852.description:
Iran says the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until its demands are met, as Trump weighs military action.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Yom Kippur in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_693880.description:
A major malfunction in the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) communications systems is causing widespread disruptions to aircraft traffic on the East Coast.

Flights at airports in New York, New Jersey and Philadelphia were delayed or grounded, and thousands of flights across the US were affected. The outage was reportedly caused by a damaged fiber-optic cable in New Jersey.

flash_693879.description: Yoav, eldest son of terror victim Netanel Shakron, recites 'Kaddish' at his father's funeral, a day after his father was killed in a terror attack hours before Yom Kippur.

flash_693877.description:
The Polish army announced that it has begun air operations in response to Russian attacks in Ukraine.

According to the Polish statement, the purpose of the activity is to ensure airspace security.

flash_693875.description: Three blasts hit weapons depots and military sites in less than two weeks, killing Syrian soldiers and prompting an investigation into possible Israeli involvement.

flash_693873.description:
Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar criticized his British counterpart Ed Miliband after Miliband posted a video touting his "strong values" even though he did not condemn the murder of an Israeli civilian in a terrorist attack in Binyamin on Sunday.

"We didn’t hear the part where you condemn the Palestinian murderer who killed a Jewish father in front of his son yesterday, on the eve of Yom Kippur," Sa'ar responded.

“Strong values"? he asked.

flash_693872.description: The Trump administration is proposing to allocate $5 billion to establish an investment fund to rehabilitate energy facilities in the Gulf, the Wall Street Journal reported.

flash_693870.description: Hamas plants explosive device that hits IDF engineering vehicle near Yellow Line; IDF strikes terrorist infrastructure, slamming 'blatant ceasefire violation.'

flash_693868.description: The Choosing Life Forum is asking the Supreme Court to allow its representatives to be present in the hearing room during deliberations on the request they submitted to the Central Elections Committee to disqualify the Ra’am party.

flash_693866.description:
Qatar strongly rejected the claims that it funded Hamas, claiming that the New Yorker investigation was based on false information and recycled and forged documents, which it said were part of an anti-Qatari campaign.

The Qatari Information Office statement claimed that elements on the far-right in Israel were behind the distribution of the documents. Doha also emphasized: "Nothing was transferred to Gaza without Israeli approval, whether it was financial aid or essential goods."

flash_693864.description: Students in Acre and Sderot yeshivas mark the end of the holiest day of the Jewish year with singing, dancing and prayers for mercy.

flash_693862.description: An explosive device exploded a short while ago on an IDF engineering vehicle operating in the northern Gaza Strip. There were no casualties.

flash_693860.description: The right is gaining strength, the left is taking Berlin: Why are Germany’s Jews watching the election results with concern?

flash_693858.description: Police officer critically wounded after gunman opens fire outside Canadian synagogue during Kol Nidre services.

flash_693856.description: According to the report, the US President deliberated for approximately two weeks, instructed the Pentagon to prepare for airstrikes in Yemen - and yesterday decided to halt the move.

flash_693854.description: Magen David Adom's blood services provided 152 units of blood and blood components to hospitals in Israel over Yom Kippur,

flash_693881.description: Crowds sing mournful, moving song at funeral of terror victim Netanel Shakron, who was murdered hours before Yom Kippur at the Ein Riya spring.

flash_693878.description: Netanel Shakron, father of six murdered at Ein Riya spring, is laid to rest in Alei Zahav.

flash_693876.description: Following the White House’s decision to bar three news organizations from entering, other media outlets have suspended the press pool that accompanies the President wherever he goes.

flash_693874.description: Hatred of Jews, anti-capitalism, Islamism, and contempt for freedom will be the pillars of the European woke capitals. When they push the Jews out and allow countless Mulims in, this is what they get. Opinion.

flash_693871.description: On the same day Iran warned of US missile strikes, it shut down a French language institute. Here’s the sinister reason why-and why Europe can no longer play neutral. Opinion.

flash_693869.description: The British Prime Minister is inclined to provide the Saudi military with operational support in order to deal with the Houthis and will work to convince other countries to help repel the rebels in Yemen, Bloomberg reported.

flash_693867.description: Rosh Yehudi draws thousands to Meir Park for the closing prayers of Yom Kippur, with worshipers gathering throughout the day.

flash_693865.description: Duvdevan soldiers arrest two terrorists planning an immediate attack as IDF forces uncover weapons, explosives materials and a weapons-manufacturing lathe during Yom Kippur operations.

flash_693863.description: A full 654 Jewish ascents recorded as worshipers pray for hours with police-approved prayer books; National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir joins Mincha service ahead of the fast.

flash_693861.description: Nearly three years after October 7, Israelis return to Hostages Square for a prayer of gratitude, remembrance and unity.

flash_693859.description: Investigation reveals terrorist returned to Ein Riya spring on eve of Yom Kippur and murdered father of six; IDF tracker’s gunfire prevented him from continuing the attack.

flash_693857.description:
The US administration plans to soon announce sanctions it will impose on the International Criminal Court in The Hague, the Washington Post reported.

In the shadow of the ongoing tension between the administration and the court, Washington would like the court to remove the international arrest warrants against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Defense Minister Yoav Gallant, and to cease investigating the American military in the war in Afghanistan.

flash_693855.description: Sirens which activated in Galilee during Yom Kippur were false alarm

flash_693886.description: President Trump praises New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani as having “great potential" ahead of their third meeting at Gracie Mansion.

flash_693885.description: Minister Amichai Chikli attends a toast hosted by “HaHazakim Mitgalim" nonprofit in Herzliya, meets wounded IDF veterans, and joins them for a surfing session.

flash_693884.description: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani again calls Netanyahu a “war criminal" ahead of the Prime Minister’s UN visit, but again acknowledges he lacks authority to arrest him.

flash_693882.description: Yoav, who survived the terrorist attack in which his father, Netanel Shakron, was murdered, pays emotional tribute to his father and thanks him for saving his life.

flash_693901.description: A Haifa court sentenced Pars Abu al-Hij'a to four and a half years in prison after he admitted to carrying out missions for an Iranian intelligence agent.

flash_693900.description: Hind Rajab Foundation files a criminal complaint in Italy against an Israeli soldier vacationing in Tuscany, alleging crimes during operations in Gaza.

flash_693899.description: How to explain the Middle East without the inconvenience of history, complexity or Palestinian agency. Opinion.

flash_693897.description: A 19-year-old man has been arrested after Durham Regional Police say he allegedly threatened online to carry out a shooting at a synagogue in the Durham Region.

flash_693895.description: The sukkah is fragile and temporary, but the welcome we create within it can be strong and lasting.

flash_693893.description: The prophet Ezekiel said that the watchman who does not warn of coming dangers is responsible for the ensuing catastrophe. A call to first-time voters: the key to pre-empting the Left’s dirty tricks to steal the forthcoming Israeli elections. Opinion.

flash_693891.description:
US Ambassador to Canada Pete Hoekstra issued a message of support for the Jewish community following the shooting outside a synagogue in Belleville, Ontario.

"My thoughts and those of the American people are with the Jewish Community in Belleville following the attack on the Sons of Jacob Synagogue as they commemorated Yom Kippur, the holiest day of the Jewish year. All Canadians should be able to worship without worrying for their safety. The United States has offered assistance to support Canadian law enforcement and the Jewish community," Hoekstra stated.

flash_693890.description:
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced that he had agreed to Saudi Arabia’s request to provide aerial refueling capabilities for defensive purposes for a limited period.

Bloomberg previously reported that Burnham was considering providing operational assistance to the Saudi military in confronting the Houthis and working with other countries to enlist their support in efforts to curb the rebels in Yemen.

flash_693888.description: Lebanese media are reporting an Israeli airstrike in the Wadi Saluki area in southern Lebanon.

flash_693883.description: Samaria Regional Council head Yossi Dagan eulogizes Netanel Shakron and calls on the government to launch a large-scale military operation: “Restore the checkpoints and exact a price on the ground."

flash_693914.description: Motaz Azaiza says he filmed Gazans assaulting hostages but withheld the footage out of concern that Israel would identify them. He also revealed pressure exerted by Hamas on journalists.

flash_693913.description:
US resident Donald Trump dismissed claims that the US is running low on munitions as "not true" and spread by "traitors."

Trump wrote on Truth Social: "The cowards and traitors would love to say the United States is low on munitions. It's not true. We have more munitions than we could ever possibly think of using, and are building them up now at levels we have never seen before. President DONALD J. TRUMP"

flash_693912.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has requested US security protection during the UN General Assembly, with the State Department agreeing to provide Diplomatic Security Service personnel after a threat assessment.

flash_693911.description: Ultimately it represents a willingness to denigrate and diminish Israel itself. Opinion.

flash_693910.description: US Secretary of State Rubio: "President Trump is open to meeting with the Iranians"

flash_693909.description: Judge Noam Sohlberg rejects Sami Abu Shehadeh’s request to postpone the hearing over his hospitalization, allowing him to participate remotely as Otzma Yehudit pushes to block his Knesset candidacy.

flash_693908.description: On Sukkot, we bind together four very different species. Their differences do not disappear. Together, however, they become a mitzvah. There is a lesson here.

flash_693907.description: Netanyahu blasts NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani over his accusations against Israel and vows to “tell the truth" about him during his upcoming UN address.

flash_693906.description: A Jew may appear non-religious on the outside, but in the depths of his soul burns the flame of Torah and the yearning for a full life blessed with closeness to Hashem.

flash_693905.description: Senior Iranian official says Tehran could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days if Washington eases military pressure and its blockade of Iranian ports.

flash_693904.description: Over 1,500 activists join a Yom Kippur “Yizkor" event accusing Israel of genocide, before protesters block the Brooklyn Bridge and dozens are arrested.

flash_693903.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz issued a series of sharp warnings to Hamas and its supporters, including Iran and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

flash_693902.description: Yom Kippur synagogue auctions reach new heights as worshipers pay tens of thousands for honors, with one Book of Jonah reading fetching 353,000 shekels.

flash_693898.description: Sixteen-year-old Yoav Shakron recounts seeing a terrorist shoot his father Netanel, fleeing under fire and returning minutes later to find him dead.

flash_693896.description: The pressing issue is whether Washington can tie its measures together so financial pressure becomes a noose that follows Iranian trade on the sea, in the air, through banks and possibly across land borders too. Opinion.

flash_693894.description: US military leaders are reportedly divided over striking the Houthis as Saudi Arabia seeks more help and Trump weighs renewed military action in Yemen.

flash_693892.description: Nehemiah Hazan came to the spring near Neve Tzuf for a pre-Yom Kippur immersion. Minutes later, he found himself trapped at the scene of a deadly attack that claimed the life of Netanel Shakron.

flash_693889.description:
The foreign ministers of the G7 countries called on Iran to halt its supply of weapons and support to the Houthi rebels in Yemen. They said the Houthis’ activities were creating a dangerous pattern of escalation that threatened international trade and global stability.

“We strongly condemn the ongoing and unacceptable attacks carried out by the Houthis in Yemen and against Saudi Arabia," the foreign ministers of the United States, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United Kingdom said after meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.

flash_693887.description: President Trump says he will hold meetings on Iran as Tehran warns the war is not over and vows to change its weapons, tactics and targets.

flash_693938.description: Trump reveals: Senior US official met with Iranian delegation for three hours

flash_693937.description: Smotrich sharply criticized the UN Secretary-General following his speech at the General Assembly: “The UN Secretary-General’s wild incitement gives a tailwind to terrorism."

flash_693935.description: The hacker group "ShinyHunters" claims to have managed to hack into the US Federal Bureau of Investigation's systems and obtain information regarding thousands of the FBI's employees.

flash_693933.description:
Sean Ward, the suspect who carried out the shooting attack near the Sons of Jacob synagogue in the town of Belleville, Ontario, died of his wounds in the hospital.

Ward was critically injured in an exchange of gunfire with Officer Jeff Smith on Yom Kippur Eve. The officer was seriously injured and is in stable condition.

flash_693931.description: British security forces announced that they had arrested two suspects on suspicion of planning to carry out a terrorist attack against the Jewish community in Manchester.

flash_693929.description:
A short while ago, 14 Israeli civilians arrived in the Alonei Habashan area and crossed the border into Syria. IDF soldiers were dispatched to the area and operated to locate them and returned the civilians to Israeli territory.

The detained civilians were transferred to the Israel Police for further handling.

flash_693927.description: Expelled from their homes and forced to live in huts and tents near the sea, the Palestinian refugees had no one to defend them - at first. Op-ed.

flash_693925.description: Itamar Ben Gvir announced that Otzma Yehudit will demand the Defense Ministry for himself and the Justice Ministry for Tally Gotliv in the next government.

flash_693923.description:
Trump at UN General Assembly: Since I took office, it has been my great honor to settle eight wars - numerous of which have gone on for many years, even decades.

The reason I was able to make all these settlements was the use of my relationships, trade, and various other reasons depending on the country.

Among them are Cambodia and Thailand, Kosovo and Serbia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda, Pakistan and India, Armenia and Azerbaijan, and of course, the war in Gaza, which, as I stated previously, includes the return of all hostages both living and dead.

flash_693922.description:
Trump at the UN General Assembly: One year ago when I addressed the great leaders in this Grand Hall, the War in Gaza was still raging brutally, the hostages were still deep in Hamas tunnels, and there was no end in sight.

But here on the sidelines of the General Assembly, we took the first steps that changed everything. A few weeks later, we ENDED the War in Gaza, saving untold thousands of lives. We also brought home ALL remaining hostages, both living and dead.

flash_693920.description: US President Donald Trump said in his address to the UN: "We have more ammunition than we could ever want. We are building it at levels never seen before."

flash_693918.description: US President Donald Trump addressed Iran in his speech at the UN, saying: "Iran used to be the bully of the Middle East, but they are no longer the bully. I will never allow Iran to obtain nuclear weapons."

flash_693916.description: Shmulik Yisrael remembers his close friend Netanel (Nati) Shakron, murdered on the eve of Yom Kippur, 'A man of truth, a man of kindness, with a huge heart. He lived a full life.'

flash_693950.description:
Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot criticized remarks by French President Emmanuel Macron, emphasizing that the Hamas terrorist organization also operates in Judea and Samaria and poses a threat to Israeli civilians.

“French President Macron’s statement is radically detached from the reality on the ground. As someone who commanded the Judea and Samaria Division and fought to eradicate Hamas terrorism, I know very well about the terrorist organization’s activities in Judea and Samaria and the threat it poses to Israeli civilians, as we witnessed just two days ago in the deadly attack in Binyamin."

flash_693949.description:
IDF surveillance soldiers on Tuesday evening detected suspicious movement along the Jordanian border in the Jordan Valley area. IDF, Border Police forces in Judea and Samaria, and the Israel Police Judea and Samaria District launched a pursuit.

According to the IDF, two suspects were apprehended shortly afterward and transferred to security forces for further questioning.

flash_693948.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office on Tuesday evening blasted French President Emmanuel Macron who claimed at the UN that Hamas "has never been very active in Judea and Samaria".

“The grotesque absurdity of Emmanuel Macron's statement is staggering. On Sunday, the eve of Yom Kippur, just two days ago, Netanel Shakron - a FRENCH CITIZEN and father of six - was murdered in his car by a Hamas terrorist in Judea and Samaria. With his final breath, he told his son to run," the statement said. “Hamas terrorists carry out attacks against Jews almost every day. They have murdered countless Israeli civilians in Judea and Samaria. Ignorance is NO EXCUSE for erasing their blood."

flash_693946.description: Human rights scholar Anne Bayefsky sharply condemns UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres following his General Assembly speech: ‘The United Nations is a very dangerous organization with enormous power.’

flash_693944.description: The French President criticized developments in Judea and Samaria and told the UN General Assembly: “Hamas has never been very active in the West Bank."

flash_693942.description: French President Emmanuel Macron referred to what is happening in Judea and Samaria and said: "Just look at what is happening in the West Bank. Day after day, we witness violations. And in the name of what? Hamas has never been particularly active in the West Bank."

flash_693940.description: Netanyahu tells slain victim’s son: 'His case could be the first to invoke the death penalty law for terrorists.'

flash_693936.description: Hackers claim to have stolen highly sensitive personal data on thousands of FBI employees, including home addresses, phone numbers and information about their spouses, after allegedly breaching bureau systems.

flash_693934.description: 14 Israelis crossed the border into Syria, calling for settlement in the area. An IDF force was dispatched, located them, and returned them to Israel. The military is demanding that legal action be taken against them.

flash_693932.description: Israel’s UN Ambassador Danny Danon praised US President Donald Trump for his address to the UN General Assembly, highlighting the US-Israel alliance, the Abraham Accords and efforts to expand the circle of peace.

flash_693930.description: Haredi journalist Yitzhak Horowitz reached Oman’s Musandam Peninsula - one of the world’s most strategic and tense locations - and shared his impressions from the area.

flash_693928.description:
US Ambassador to Israel reiterated America's demand that the Palestinian Authority end its 'pay for slay' policy following Sunday's deadly shooting attack in Binyamin.

"The US has long demanded that the PA end 'pay for slay' that rewards terrorists for murdering Jews. There will be no peace or a path forward until payment for murder ends," Huckabee stated.

flash_693926.description: Yoav Shakron, son of Netanel Shakron, recalls his final conversation and pre-Yom Kippur immersion with his father: 'He always smiled and made sure others smiled too.'

flash_693924.description: Antonio Guterres accuses Israel of 'killing and destruction unlike anything I have witnessed in my years as Secretary-General' following October 7, rails against settlements.

flash_693921.description: US President Donald Trump said in his address to the UN General Assembly that he believes a deal with Iran will be reached immediately after the midterm elections.

flash_693955.description:
A 17-year-old girl was moderately injured after the motorcycle she was riding was struck by a vehicle in Modi’in.

Magen David Adom paramedics evacuated her to Shamir-Assaf Harofeh Hospital.

flash_693954.description: Speaking in New York, Syrian President Ahmad al-Sharaa says Israel withdrew from security talks after the sides had nearly reached an agreement, while insisting the Golan Heights are Syrian.

flash_693953.description: Lebanese media reported that the IDF carried out a large controlled explosion near the town of Khiam in southern Lebanon.

flash_693951.description: Iranian media reported that explosions were heard coming from the sea near Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_693947.description: The Wortsmans refused to rest, maintaining the struggle to free Soviet Jewry through dark and difficult years until the regime finally collapsed, resulting in the historic exodus of over a million Soviet Jews to Israel. In memoriam.

flash_693945.description: Weeks before October 7, a message was received from Sinwar about an “earthquake in the prisons." Israel’s security establishment assessed that it was connected to Tsurkov.

flash_693943.description: Residents of north informed: Explosions will be heard following strikes in Lebanon

flash_693939.description:
Yosef Haddad, an advocacy activist and candidate number 2 on the "Amach Yisrael" list, received a series of e-mails this evening containing explicit threats to his life, including: "We will cut off your fingers one by one and dismember your body along with the Americans."

According to the party's statement, it is believed that the threats were sent by elements linked to the Iranian regime.

flash_693967.description: Argentine President Javier Milei made a festive stop at a New York yeshiva and danced with the students during his US visit for the UN General Assembly.

flash_693966.description: MK Avigdor Liberman’s Yisrael Beytenu party says Ra’am, the Joint List, Ofer Cassif and Sami Abu Shehadeh have no place in Knesset.

flash_693964.description: Macron’s false statement about Hamas is grotesque, but the real story is the lethal "palestine" fairytale dreamed up by the KGB and now believed the world over. Op-ed.

flash_693962.description: Rabbi Marc Schneier accuses New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani of fueling antisemitism after Mamdani again called Netanyahu an “architect of genocide."

flash_693960.description: Three Israeli Bedouins were detained on their way back from Sharm el-Sheikh six months ago. Their families still do not know where they are being held or what condition they are in.

flash_693958.description: The man suspected of opening fire on a police officer outside a Belleville synagogue has died.

flash_693956.description: Israel’s UN Ambassador Danny Danon slams French President after he claimed Hamas has never been active in Judea and Samaria.

flash_693952.description: President Trump says that the US could “blow up" Pickaxe Mountain near Natanz if Iran resumes nuclear activity at the site.

flash_693941.description: After beating cancer once, 7-year-old Chaim is facing it again. Help his family get him to the US for the advanced treatment he urgently needs.
